newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid mixed cargo market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid mixed cargo market.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted little changed from Tuesday amid mixed views on near term cargo prices, traders said.

A shipowner said the market was quiet as some buyers were mixed on near term market direction. One trader said: "Bunker prices will depend on how cargo prices move. Currently cargo prices were steady to firm with signs of Chinese demand."
But there are also increased MidEast supplies, he added.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted around $123 a tonne and 380 cst at $120. MDO was quoted at $209 with gas oil at $218-220.
